lead: Cinematic sci-fi film still, brutalist warships carved from grey moon rock, violet glow and teal lights.
notes: Mood-only mini images for bunkership.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen bunkership-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish bunkership-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.
